Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class TransferGameTests

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.TransferGameTests
public final class TransferGameTests extends Object
Held-item transfer coverage. The loader-neutral cases live in TransferScenarios; this class adds the Forge-specific paths: PlayerInteractEvent priority around a foreign main-hand transfer, and the synchronous Transfers settlement of multi-count overflow.
